topic: A homeowner discovers previous residents left items in the attic
text: There be old things in the attic, left by them as was here before us. I never thought to find such. The rafters creak, and shadows dance when the wind howls through. It's not right, these remnants of lives bound to this place even as they've gone on. What had they hid? Why did they leave it all behind? Each piece a whisper of secrets, of times I know not of. The walls themselves seem to speak of those days, though no words are heard. I should bring them down, give them to the poor or burn them, but the thought of touching them turns my stomach. They must be gone, but the thought of the attic door closing behind me brings little ease.
